data.action: 立于山巅仰望银河伸臂虚握流星
data.camera: wide shot, standing on a mountain peak with one arm outstretched
data.description: 【令 · 云海山巅观星】绝顶之上，云海在脚下翻涌成浪，银河横贯天际。令立于山巅青石之上，极长的蓝发在夜风中如瀑飘散，龙角映着星辉，墨青旗袍的下摆轻轻翻飞。她抬手虚握一颗流星的余光，声音飘渺如吟——「朝菌不知晦朔，蟪蛄不知春秋。而我看过太多春秋，仍觉得人间有趣。」
data.lighting: starry sky glow, pale blue moonlight, drifting cloud mist rim light
data.promptProse: On a blue-stone mountain crest, Ling extends one arm toward the fading trail of a meteor, her extremely long blue hair and ink-teal robe streaming in the wind. Retain the wide view with the Milky Way overhead and the cloud sea far below. The nearest cracked stone ledge runs diagonally beneath her feet; beyond it, overlapping bands of cloud recede toward a lower distant ridge. Pale blue moonlight catches the upper plane of the rock, the edge of her horns and the wind-lifted sleeve. The lee side of the crest stays dark, separating her grounded stance from the luminous clouds without adding a new light source.
data.title: 令 · 云海山巅观星
